verdict.rationale: Zoho Books documents genuine event/condition-based automation: 'Trigger workflow' rules to notify/update/validate on events, Bank Rules API for auto-categorizing transactions, and Zia AI turning data into automatic next steps (bulk reminders, categorization, Blueprints). MCP integration also lets AI agents trigger actions from natural instructions, corroborated by customer quotes. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of rule complexity/reliability, and detailed docs on the full workflow-rule builder (trigger types, conditions, action chaining) beyond marketing copy.
